What is Amazon EC2?

Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) provides on-demand, scalable computing capacity in the AWS Cloud.

Features

  • Instances: Virtual servers.
  • AMIs: Preconfigured templates.

Example

aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-123 --count 1

See Instances for details.

External link: EC2 product page.
